rationale: The interpreter output contains several critical defects: it reverses the definitions of AC and EC, and it omits all explicit business requirements from the ticket, including UI display rules and detailed input specifications. These gaps prevent reliable implementation of the condenser configuration feature.

findings.description: The interpreter incorrectly defines AC as Evaporative Cooled and EC as Air Cooled, reversing the definitions provided in the ticket.
findings.action: Correct the business rule so that AC means Air Cooled and EC means Evaporative Cooled, or remove the incorrect rule.

sourceRefs.quote: AC means Evaporative Cooled and EC means Air Cooled.

findings.description: The interpreter does not capture the requirement to display the appropriate condenser input fields when the user selects AC or EC.
findings.action: Add a business rule or requirement that specifies the UI must show the AC input fields for AC selection and the EC input fields for EC selection.

sourceRefs.quote: When the user selects the Condenser Type "AC" or "EC", the corresponding input fields should be displayed.

findings.description: The interpreter omits the acceptance criterion that selecting Condenser Passes shall display AutoOdd, AutoEven, and numbers 2 through 41 in increments of 1.
findings.action: Include this acceptance criterion in the business rules or requirement summary.

sourceRefs.quote: When they select Condenser Passes, Then the system shall display AutoOdd, AutoEven, and 2 through 41 in increments of 1 as options.

findings.description: The interpreter omits the acceptance criterion that selecting Roof Type shall display the specified dark and light roof type options with and without parapet/shrouding.
findings.action: Add this acceptance criterion to the interpreter output.

sourceRefs.quote: When they select Roof Type, Then the system shall display the specified dark and light roof type options with and without parapet/shrouding.

findings.description: The interpreter fails to capture the detailed AC and EC condenser input fields listed in the ticket (e.g., Design Ambient, ASHRAE Summer Design, Condenser Tube Material, Bank ID#, Wet Bulb Temperature, etc.).
findings.action: Add business rules that enumerate all required input fields for both AC and EC condenser configurations.
